data_contract.timestamp_semantics: NAIVE_BROKER_SOURCE_TIME; no UTC conversion or offset inference
data_contract.identity_source: ea/baseline/Max_MTF.mq5::training CSV writer and first-write-wins identity check

writer_contract.lock: training lock file opened with exclusive sharing; ONNX reads only while lock can be acquired without creating or changing it
writer_contract.csv: FILE_COMMON with FILE_SHARE_READ; training writes, FileFlush and closes before releasing lock

source_discovery.override: Owner-selected absolute path only when its resolved file remains under the approved canonical root

snapshot_contract.capture: Acquire the existing EA lock read-only; validate regular-file identity and filesystem fingerprint before/after byte capture; enforce the bounded source-size and capture-time limits.
snapshot_contract.partial_read: Reject missing final line terminator, parse errors, source mutation, lock contention, unsupported path, or any before/after fingerprint mismatch.
snapshot_contract.publication: Write exact captured bytes to same-volume staging, flush, verify SHA-256, make artifact read-only, then atomically publish content-addressed snapshot; persist lineage and audit metadata transactionally.
snapshot_contract.retry: Same content and identity are idempotent; conflicting DB identity, hash mismatch, or tampered published artifact fails closed.
snapshot_contract.duplicates: Conflicting identities block. Identical duplicate removal requires explicit confirmation and produces a new derived immutable snapshot with original/backup/before/after hashes and row count; the live source and parent snapshot are never edited.

checks: CP32 feature contract and source lineage
duplicate identity and conflicting row detection
data_quality_contract.gap_rule: Observed timestamp spacing is not proof of broker data loss or completeness. ONNX-02 has no source-backed broker-history channel or approved repair/disposition authority; real broker reconciliation therefore remains pending. No mean/fill/interpolation/synthetic OHLC or CP32 repair is allowed.
data_quality_contract.dq_status_boundary: Schema/row blockers are DQ blockers; an observed timestamp gap is a distinct RECONCILIATION_PENDING finding and does not by itself rewrite broker status.

requirements: all ranges are covered by the same verified immutable snapshot
timezone-naive boundaries exactly match recorded source provenance
persisted snapshot hash and window identity are immutable and replay-verified
Forward does not grow after validation
research_windows.execution: Configuration and validation only; no Discovery, WFA, CPCV, Tournament, Monte Carlo, or Forward evaluation.

requires: verified broker reconciliation or a separately Owner-authorized policy disposition

api_contract.source_of_truth: Backend validation and persisted snapshot/window/readiness evidence; frontend may not create readiness or DQ state.
api_contract.compatibility: Do not change frozen /api/v1/onnx/workspace null-only ONNX-01 response contract.

evidence_boundary.local_ci: Synthetic fixtures only; evidence class is SYNTHETIC_TEST_EVIDENCE.
